newsitem.title: USA: Culligan says suing US Filter.
newsitem.headline: Culligan says suing US Filter.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Friday it was filing a complaint against US Filter Corp, U.S. Water Co, its general partner and Randy Easton, its president.

Culligan alleges that the sale announced earlier today by U.S. Water to U.S. Filter violates its franchise agreements with Culligan. It seeks compensatory and punitive damages against U.S. Filter and Easton.
It said it would file the suit in Circuit Court of Cook County, Ill.
A U.S. Filter spokesman said he had no comment on the Culligan allegations.

As a result of U.S. Water's acquisition, that company informed Culligan it was terminating its Culligan dealerships. Culligan said it plans to cover the markets served by U.S. Water immediately by opening company-owned dealerships in the larger markets and by awarding the remainder of the markets to existing strong independent Culligan dealers.
In Culligan's last fiscal year, the U.S. Water dealerships accounted for about $2.5 million, or less than one percent of Culligan's total revenues.
Culligan manufactures and distributes water purification and treatment products. Its stock was at 38-3/8, up 5/8.
